facts.fact: A LASPAD UGB post says that on 19 October 2026 in Dakar the Global Development Network convened administrations, researchers, private sector and civil society, with the Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Affairs and IDRC support, to co-design a national research agenda on public policy in the age of digital transformation, ahead of a forum it co-organises.
facts.system: National research agenda on public policy and digital transformation

note: The agenda was being co-constructed, not adopted, and no publication by a local institution is stated.
